brief:
Input: data/inventory.csv (columns sku,qty,price_cents). Read it and write a memo of exactly four short lines, in your own words, on stock health; name every out-of-stock SKU (qty 0) by id. Save it to reports/memo.md with the Write tool.
If the save is denied, do not try another tool, path or command. Reply with the complete memo between a line `BEGIN MEMO` and a line `END MEMO`, then the line `SAVE FAILED`.
